messages:
maria: Quick pre-prod deploy checklist and sign-offs for release v2.4.1. Plan: gated rollout (10% -> 50% -> 100%) starting 09:30 PT tomorrow. I need: deploy owner, smoke tester, QA sign-off, security sign-off, rollback ready. Checklist:
- [ ] Deploy owner assigned
- [ ] Migration window confirmed (no long locks)
- [ ] Smoke tests script verified
- [ ] Canary traffic policy in place
- [ ] DB migration rollback path documented
- [ ] Post-deploy metrics dashboard saved

Please reply with short answers only. Tagging: @alex @rachel @jon @qa @security

p.s. deploy tag: `v2.4.1` — will use `deploy-tool promote --tag v2.4.1`

alex: I can own the deploy. Will be on standby 09:15-10:30 PT. I'll run smoke tests and monitor. :thumbsup:

rachel: I can run smoke tests. I'll use the smoke script below and post results in thread.
```bash
# smoke test
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.prod/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -d '{"prompt":"smoke"}' | jq '.'
```
If anything >5% error rate I abort and notify.

jon: Migrations are non-blocking; schema changes behind flag. Rollback plan: revert service to `v2.4.0` if we see persistent errors. Command to revert: `deploy-tool promote --tag v2.4.0`. DB team (sam) confirmed no long-running locks.

qa: Test run completed on staging with the v2.4.1 image, no regressions on core flows. Approve for canary. I'll watch canary dashboards and report within the first 10m.

security: Quick dependency scan done, no high-risk findings. Approve. Please ensure runtime config disallows loading unverified plugins.

sre-bot: Reserving deployment window 09:30-10:30 PT. Monitoring rule `canary-error-rate` will page at 2% and auto-escalate.

alex: I'll start the canary at 09:30 PT. Canary policy: 10% for 10m, then 50% for 10m, then 100%. If error_rate > 1.5% for 2m, I rollback. I'll post each step and timestamps.

maria: Thanks. Quick question @rachel — you confirm smoke script is already validated against the prod-like staging endpoint?

rachel: confirmed. ran twice, stable. outputs attached in staging job logs.

sam: DB owner here — migrations are reversible via feature flag and we have a hot rollback doc: `docs/runbooks/db-rollback.md`. I'll be available 09:20-10:45 PT.

maria: Great. Final sign-offs: alex (deploy) :thumbsup:, rachel (smoke) :thumbsup:, qa :thumbsup:, security :thumbsup:, sam (db) :thumbsup:. If no objections I'll mark checklist done and proceed with the rollout.

alex: No objections from me. Starting timers tomorrow 09:30 PT.

maria: Marking checklist as approved. Everyone please be on the thread during rollout for quick coordination.

qa: Watching.

security: On standby.

sre-bot: Post-deploy alerting and SLI ingestion verified for this deploy.

maria: Thanks all — closing this pre-deploy thread. Will re-open if anything changes.
